summary.text: DET ISLAMSKE FELLESSKAP BOSNIA OG HERZEGOVINA is an association registered in Oslo, founded 1994-02-10. DET ISLAMSKE FELLESSKAP BOSNIA OG HERZEGOVINA practises the Islamic faith, carries out humanitarian work, does information work, and works with and maintains contact with Bosnian refugees. Its main industry code is 94.910: activities of religious organisations. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 23 023 460 NOK and the annual result was -569 233 NOK; operating income was up from 22 233 473 NOK in 2024. The annual result fell from 821 853 NOK in 2024 to -569 233 NOK in 2025. Equity fell from 31 706 138 NOK in 2024 to 31 136 905 NOK in 2025. Recent changes in the register: employees set to 11 on 2026-02-13.
